newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait releases five Iraqis after investigation.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait releases five Iraqis after investigation.

text.p: Kuwait said on Monday it had released five Iraqis arrested for allegedly violating its territorial waters.

"They have been sent to the competent authorities for interrogation and then they were released," Interior Ministry spokesman Colonel Bader Saleh said in a statement. The International Committee of the Red Cross had been notified.

The statement did not say when the five were arrested. Iraqi newspapers reported on Monday that they were fishermen who were abducted by Kuwait's coastal guard on February 22 while inside Iraqi waters close to Mina al-Bakr and al-Amiya port.

"They were subjected to arbitary measures during their detention...They were taken with their hands tied to state security offices in Kuwait City where they were tortured and charged with espionage," the newspapers charged.
Quoting an Iraq News Agency reporter in the area, they said the fishermen were seized within the demilitarised zone.
